decision_semantics.independently_corroborated: The source provides claim-specific support based on independent observation, testing, third-party documentation, or a reproducible absence check.
decision_semantics.mixed: The exact claim combines independent material with first-party statements or material.
decision_semantics.disputed: The source repeats or relies on first-party material, or the independence of its support cannot be resolved safely.
decision_semantics.excluded: The source or claim case is ineligible for independent corroboration.

notes: All ten candidates are bound to literal spans in an immutable real Vercel capture.
The five parent sources were already reviewed for identity and publisher independence.
Candidate claim statements are review subjects, not canonical claims.
No candidate carries a proposed decision.
Provisional review files can be evaluated while authority is false; their fingerprint is frozen only when a reviewed dataset version is adopted.
Decision and revocation events form append-only per-case chains.
No review has runtime, scoring, canonical-selection, or operational-registry authority.
